Around [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM}} dates the beginning of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series to [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. As the main events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', the second instalment of the series, are dated to 43 ABY by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', its events must take place in 43.5 ABY. Therefore, ''Omen''{{'s}} flashbacks to two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before its main events, which take place during the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s first attacks on [[Starship/Legends|ships]] they wished to add to their [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith armada]], must take place around [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]]. As the short story "[[First Blood (short story)|First Blood]]" depicts one of the first attacks by the Lost Tribe of Sith on ships to take for their armada, its events must also take place around 41.5 ABY.</ref> a [[Damorian Manufacturing Corporation/Legends|Damorian]] [[S18 light freighter]] was forced to land on '''planet''' after being [[Skirmish near Eriadu|ambushed]] by the [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] and five [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] from the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. After staying behind at the ship's landing site, [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] discovered a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[First|girl]] who had gone unnoticed. Khai [[Death/Legends|killed]] her, making the girl, who Khai dubbed "First," the first person Khai had ever killed. The planet was [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]], with open [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] plains that had patches of mud and soil speckled throughout and [[Forest/Legends|forested]] hills.<ref name="First" />
